remarks: Set on over two private acres along the Wilton/Weston border, this architecturally distinct Contemporary offers a compelling blend of design, privacy & setting. Ideally positioned in southern Wilton, the home offers rare convenience-just minutes to Wilton Center, Weston, Westport & Georgetown. A circular drive leads to the home, where striking vertical siding and thoughtfully designed grounds create an immediate impression. Inside, quality craftsmanship & elevated design define the space. The entry opens to expansive living areas anchored by a statement staircase, including a living room w/ walls of glass & exceptional window placement that flood the home w/ natural light. A cherry-paneled library w/ built-ins and detailed millwork. The kitchen features high-end appliances including Wolf, SubZero & Miele w/ ample workspace & storage, flowing seamlessly into the family room w/ fireplace, surround sound, and access to an oversized Brazilian Ipe deck. A 20x24 sunroom & stone terrace create multiple outdoor entertaining areas, complemented by a hot tub and professionally landscaped grounds w/ extensive lighting for a dramatic nighttime setting. The primary suite offers a private balcony, walk-in closet, and updated spa-like bath. Three additional bedrooms complete the level. The finished lower level offers flexible space and storage. Newer HVAC system & new driveway. Extensive improvements, inquire for full list. Located in a top-rated school district. Welcome Home!
